title: Independent TABLE physical profiles and original common-role joins
scope: Admitted original DXF ACAD_TABLE scalar/subclass/reference profiles and selected ENTITIES/BLOCKS structural owner, space and layout joins. Not full TABLE payload/dependency/live/output, native collation, CAD semantics or whole-document qualification.
implementation: Inventory original parent physical scalars independently of dxfReader/TABLE decoder/model replay, with exact original indexes, ignored comments, subclass, cell/value/override/application/XDATA scopes.
Keep structural owner330 distinct from TABLESTYLE342, geometry BLOCK_RECORD343, cell BLOCK_RECORD340, FIELD344, cell ATTDEF331, names and opaque application references.
Pin profiles to bounded original source/typed model and pre-copy state replay certificates; precharge profile/control/vector/span retention and work before allocations.
Join original TABLE and ATTRIB/SEQEND chains to original namespace/dispatch/member/publisher owners and actual67/410 targets; validate wire owners separately from logical sequence parents.
Keep absent versus explicit layout, ordinary definitions versus associated LAYOUT targets, and unsupported/omitted original census records distinct.

Refuse unmodeled CadValue and table-global schemas, nonstring declarations overwritten by existing text parsing, unknown subclasses and schema substitutions; no production parser acceptance or public callback/vtable changes.
Keep reports allocation-free and container/generation/owner bound; live edits do not rewrite immutable original evidence; no support/output gate promotion.

validation.notAPerformanceComparison: Normal uses two CTest workers; ASan/O1 uses four. Different flags/scheduling and uncontrolled host conditions do not establish throughput improvement or absence of regression.
